structs.name: OnlineProgression
structs.size_evidence: One-local-client layout (Replay PC build, LocalClientGlobals one slot, controller index 0 only). Replay's highest access is the level element: UpdateProgression@0x141060490 writes level_xp at a1+16*(0+974)=15584 and level at 15592 (QWORD), so the object is at least 15600 bytes (8-byte aligned). Init@0x141059050 also clears 15584 and 15592. Best estimate 15600, but NOT proven: the global map contradicts a single contiguous object. OnlineProgression::s_instance@0x144483CE0 (GetInstance@0x14105BC30 returns its address; its first qword is 0x14241D9E0, the vtable) has named globals inside its 15600-byte footprint: s_LUI_flagBooleanTable at +11400 (read by LUI_CoD_LuaCall_GetFlagBoolean@0x141059BCC), serializable at +11408 (dynamic initializer for hkcdObb@0x140340BC9), and s_OnlineFlaggedStringInstance0 at +15624 (dynamic initializer FlaggedString@0x140340BF6). Either those names are wrong or the Replay writes at 11400+ do not go to this global. Not resolved. Game-test 124576 is not supported.

structs.notes: With one local client every per-controller array is one element, and the Replay code's overlaps disappear: season progression fills 80..192 exactly (memset 112), the challenge array fills 192..11392 exactly (memset 11200), count sits at 11392 right after it, the bool block at 11400 is 4 bytes, and the level element ends the object at 15600. The 11400-byte extent of s_instance does not hold: the named globals at +11400 and +11408 are referenced by their own code (LUI_CoD_LuaCall_GetFlagBoolean@0x141059BCC and the hkcdObb dynamic initializer at 0x140340BC9), and +15624 is a FlaggedString initializer. Either those names belong to other objects and the Replay writes at 15584 hit another object (impossible if the code is right), or the object is not one .data global. Needs the owner or a deeper pass on how OnlineProgression_* receive their this pointer before pinning the size. Renames NOT applied: 0x141059260 is named NavPathfind3DHolder_scalar_deleting_dtor_141059260 but stores SvClientMP_mangledDtor_vftable and calls an unsized bdMemory::deallocate_5; it sits in this object's vtable at slot 15, so it may be misnamed but gives no size.
